title: Fixed #36709 -- Included staticmethods in system check for UserModel.is_anonymous/is_authenticated methods.
description:
#### Trac ticket number

ticket-36709

#### Branch description
Fix auth system check to detect staticmethod/classmethod overrides of is_authenticated and is_anonymous. Replace isinstance(..., MethodType) with callable(...) in django/contrib/auth/checks.py, add a regression test in tests/auth_tests/test_checks.py, and remove the unused MethodType import.
